data_recipe.sequence_order: continuous object -> physical shift -> fixed within-sequence optics -> pixel integration -> radiometry/noise/quantization
data_recipe.coverage_policy: match observed real failure types, not fixed SEM evaluation shapes or copied evaluation pixels
data_recipe.real_training_extension: only new/source-disjoint acquisitions; noisy-repeat targets may teach denoising if independence holds, not unknown geometry or super-resolution truth
data_recipe.real_SEM_training_extension: only independent training objects; geometry supervision not SEM-to-optical grayscale copying

first_bounded_comparison.optimizer: AdamW, numerical proposal pending gradient and memory smoke checks
first_bounded_comparison.runtime_and_GPU_memory: not_measured; do not promise completion time
first_bounded_comparison.activation_checkpointing: per iteration and residual blocks; actual memory must be profiled before launch
first_bounded_comparison.early_checkpoint_role: diagnostic development only; no cherry-picked early-versus-final model comparison
first_bounded_comparison.core_coverage: Log shape/texture/edge pixels inside the 128 native supervised center; reject or resample empty/mislabelled cores before training based only on generator truth
first_bounded_comparison.control_definition: All three use the same 2x state, four shared prior calls, residual feature inputs and observation training loss. First control omits only explicit observation-gradient steps. This is not a claim that all physical information is removed.
first_bounded_comparison.shared_weight_identity: Construct common tensor bank once per seed and copy/check every shared tensor; use independent sample RNG. Seed equality alone is insufficient.
first_bounded_comparison.geometry_control: Allocate geometry head for all models; only the declared geometry-supervision and consistency losses differ in final arm; no head output enters external scorer.
first_bounded_comparison.sample_budget: 512 scenes, 2 full passes, 1 scene per update =1024; two views of each scene paired in a microbatch. Activation checkpointing permitted, no silent effective-batch changes.

loss_contract.image: known optical target after native integration; foreground and texture strata retained separately
loss_contract.observation: qualified measured-noise likelihood in native sensor units
loss_contract.geometry: independent latent truth; never fit production objects to SEM answers
loss_contract.motion: known synthetic motion or source-disjoint independently measured real motion; real command alone not exact label
loss_contract.identity: no invented structure for already-correct/flat inputs
loss_contract.weights: freeze after implementation-only dimensional/gradient checks, before the first real candidate comparison; no tuning to synthetic position score

long_training: not scheduled; unset application thresholds mean exploratory short runs only. A decision-bearing real run must freeze primary benefit and promotion/guard limits before its first outputs are observed.
calibration_ancestry: Track separately. The same explicitly independent instrument calibration may be shared across sample splits; calibration fitted from evaluated objects is forbidden. New-calibration generalization is a distinct claim.
initial_training_source_availability: Only new independently generated scenes are specified as immediately constructible. New real training acquisitions and independently paired SEM training objects have not been acquired/admitted.
